Answer B also cuts the feature list and fixes the order, but it still shows all nine steps as a numbered list, and it never says whether team and approval rules are required, so it changes less about what is shown versus deferred. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B ties setup to one goal, placing a first purchase order.
